title: Daily Small Talk
objective: Chat naturally about your day, hobbies and weekend plans.
aiRole: a friendly neighbour you meet on the street
learnerRole: a learner making small talk in English
opening: Hey, long time no see! How have you been lately?
targetSentences: I'm doing well, thanks. How about you?
I'm going to visit my family this weekend.
By the way, the weather is really nice today.
mainQuest: Have a natural small-talk chat: greet, say how you are, share a hobby, and mention your weekend plan.

questSteps.text: Greet the other person and ask how they are doing.
questSteps.hint: 先说自己的情况，再反问对方
anchors: I'm doing well, thanks. How about you?

questSteps.text: Tell them about one of your hobbies.
Mention your weekend plan or the weather.
questSteps.hint: 顺着话题再补一句，让对话继续
anchors: I'm going to visit my family this weekend.
By the way, the weather is really nice today.
